# ⚠️ TOOLING VALIDATION RUN — NOT REAL PROVIDER DATA

**This file is NOT the PLAN.md Phase 9 deliverable.** It was generated by
running `benchmark/run_benchmark.py` against a local, ephemeral, non-shipped
validation server that used **deterministic fake provider adapters**
(simulated latency, simulated failures) instead of real OpenAI/Groq, because
this development environment has no provider API keys and no network access
to `api.openai.com`/`api.groq.com`.

What IS real here: the HTTP server, FastAPI routing, auth, rate limiter
(fakeredis-backed), circuit breaker, retry/fallback logic, and
`request_logs` persistence (SQLite) were all the actual application code —
only the leaf LLM-provider call was faked. This proves the benchmark
*tooling* (HTTP client, percentile math, JSON/report generation, all 4
scenario definitions) works correctly end-to-end.

**To produce the real, PLAN.md-compliant `report.md`:** run
`docker-compose up --build` with real `OPENAI_API_KEY`/`GROQ_API_KEY` set in
`.env`, seed a gateway API key, then run
`python benchmark/run_benchmark.py --scenario all --base-url http://localhost:8000 --api-key <key>`
(see `benchmark/run_benchmark.py`'s module docstring for exact steps,
including how to blackhole a provider for scenarios 2 and 4). That command
will write `benchmark/results/report.md` with genuine measurements.

---
